### Planning Intelligence Log

- **Session date**: 2026-05-21
- **Brainstorm path**: enrich-in-place (per epic a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 prior session pattern for stories 5362-7f18 and ad70-f38a)
- **Approach selected**: Approach A — structural proxy with load-bearing anchors + sentinel-fail tests
- **Approach decision**: docs/adr/0017-agent-dispatch-test-strategy.md (Decision Outcome)
- **Alternatives considered**:
  - Approach B (hybrid: structural proxy + manual smoke-test recipe) — deferred to future story; no current failure mode requires live-LLM fidelity check
  - Approach C (recorded-fixture LLM dispatches) — rejected; tests script-level API caller, not SKILL dispatch
  - Approach D (mocked HTTP endpoint) — rejected; same trade-off as Approach C, plus no project-internal precedent for SKILL-dispatch HTTP mocking
- **Test sourcing approach**: assertions target load-bearing surfaces only (file paths, heading literals referenced by name, cross-file dependency edges). User-guided away from change-detector patterns (anti-pattern per behavioral-testing-standard.md).
- **Test location**: tests/scripts/ (precedent: test-closure-checks-classifier-pass.sh, test-coherence-walkthrough.sh, test-closure-checks-migration-preview.sh)
- **DD6 regression-detection guarantee**: sentinel-fail mode (--sentinel flag) on each test script — mutates source-of-truth file copies to strip anchors and asserts test fails on mutated copy
- **Cross-epic interactions**: parent epic a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 is open; this is the final story (S3) under a03c per the prior session pattern. No conflicting epics identified
- **Web research (Step 2.6)**: skipped — no new external dependency, no new API integration, no novel architectural pattern; extends existing structural-test precedent verifier-corpus-replay.sh and tests/fixtures/verifier-corpus/
- **Scenario analysis (Step 2.75)**: not triggered — story scope is two self-contained shell tests + one ADR; SIMPLE story (≤6 DDs, internal test infrastructure, no integration signals)
- **LLM-instruction signal (Step 5)**: not triggered — story modifies tests/scripts/ + docs/adr/ only; no SKILL.md, no agent file, no prompts/ file modified. Test scripts contain no agent-prompt content.
- **Scrutiny pipeline outcome**: structural-proxy path skipped formal scrutiny per the "drop the ceremony" pattern established for stories 5362-7f18 and ad70-f38a under this epic — story description has been enriched in place with locked decisions and is the source of truth for downstream implementation/verification
- **scale_context**: not applicable (no volume-sensitive surfaces; ~36 assertions across 2 test scripts)
- **Deferred items**: live-dispatch smoke-test recipe (`scripts/closure-checks-e2e-smoke.sh`) — not blocking; can be added later if structural proxy misses a real regression
